claim: Assemble the constructed original good-place lattices with explicit finite excluded-place inputs, derive global finite support and all finite bounds, and feed the original metricSections consumer while retaining archimedean/Hodge/KS obligations.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.constructed_input: The actual original PointField, original t=32u/v, original J² section evaluations and original rational branch frame are retained. The good finite norms are the ones constructed from actual relative cotangent fibers and embedded valuation-ring lattices in the preceding closure.
obligations.justification: The actual original PointField, original t=32u/v, original J² section evaluations and original rational branch frame are retained. The good finite norms are the ones constructed from actual relative cotangent fibers and embedded valuation-ring lattices in the preceding closure.

obligations.name: Indices
obligations.constructed_input: Every finite place is split into the exact denominator-unit good set and its proved finite complement. No place or section index is omitted. The archimedean inputs cover every actual InfinitePlace and both original section values.
obligations.justification: Every finite place is split into the exact denominator-unit good set and its proved finite complement. No place or section index is omitted. The archimedean inputs cover every actual InfinitePlace and both original section values.

obligations.name: Domain
obligations.constructed_input: The original five-form avoidance, all original twist values and explicit arithmetic denominator remain unchanged. The excluded-place subtype consists exactly of places with v(δ) not equal to one. Its finiteness is proved from nonvanishing of the original denominator.
obligations.justification: The original five-form avoidance, all original twist values and explicit arithmetic denominator remain unchanged. The excluded-place subtype consists exactly of places with v(δ) not equal to one. Its finiteness is proved from nonvanishing of the original denominator.

obligations.name: Coefficients
obligations.constructed_input: At good places, no scalar or lattice can be supplied by the caller. At excluded places, the residual input is an explicit nonzero field generator and membership of both original section values in its actual valuation-ring principal lattice. This input is not asserted to come from a regular bad-prime model or the required Hodge/KS comparison.

obligations.constructed_input: Good-place positivity and section bounds are constructed. Excluded-place positivity and bounds follow from the specified generator and actual norm-membership theorem. No separate finite-support premise is requested for residual data, because its domain is already proved finite.

The actual original metricSections constructor receives this same assembled canonical FrameNorms, with no replacement section field, scalar pair or coordinate.
